articles.title_en: The paradox of safe asset creation
articles.abstract_en: Safe asset demand increases loan risk. This arises in a competitive model in which securitization vehicles create safe assets by pooling loan payoffs purchased from loan originators. Equity investors allocate their wealth between originators, who need skin-in-the-game due to moral hazard, and vehicles, who need loss-absorption capacity against aggregate risk. An increase in demand for safety fosters safe asset creation through a securitization boom: originators sell more of their loan payoffs to vehicles, equity is reallocated from originators to vehicles, and the two effects contribute to an increase in loan risk. The model is consistent with a broad set of facts in the run-up to the Global Financial Crisis.
articles.abstract_cn: 安全资产需求增加了贷款风险。这出现在一个竞争性模型中，其中证券化工具通过汇集从贷款发起人处购买的贷款收益来创造安全资产。股权投资者将财富分配在发起人（由于道德风险需要风险共担）和工具（需要针对总体风险的损失吸收能力）之间。安全需求的增加通过证券化繁荣促进了安全资产的创造：发起人向工具出售更多贷款收益，股权从发起人重新分配至工具，这两种效应共同导致贷款风险增加。该模型与全球金融危机前的一系列广泛事实相符。

articles.title_en: Capability accumulation and conglomeratization in the information age
articles.title_cn: 信息时代的 capability 积累与企业集团化
articles.abstract_en: The past twenty years have witnessed the emergence of internet conglomerates fueled by acquisitions. We build a simple model of network formation to study this. Following the resource-based view of competitive advantage from the management literature we endow firms with capabilities which drive their competitiveness across markets. Firms can merge to combine their capabilities, spin-off new firms by partitioning their capabilities, or procure unassigned capabilities. We study stable industry structures (stable networks) in which none of these deviations are profitable. We find an upper and lower bound on the size of the largest firm, and show that as markets value more of the same capabilities abrupt increases in these bounds occur.
articles.abstract_cn: 过去二十年见证了由收购推动的互联网企业集团的出现。我们构建了一个简单的网络形成模型来研究这一现象。遵循管理学文献中基于资源的竞争优势观点，我们赋予企业能力，这些能力驱动它们在各市场中的竞争力。企业可以通过合并来组合其能力，通过分割其能力来分拆新企业，或获取未分配的能力。我们研究稳定的行业结构（稳定网络），在这种结构中，这些偏离行为均无利可图。我们找到了最大企业规模的上下界，并表明随着市场对更多相同能力的重视，这些界限会发生突变性增加。

articles.title_en: Efficiency and surplus distribution in majoritarian reputational bargaining
articles.title_cn: 多数规则下声誉讨价还价中的效率与剩余分配
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies majoritarian reputational bargaining. Three agents bargain over the division of one dollar under majority rule, and proposers are randomly chosen. Each agent has private information about whether she is a rational type that maximizes her expected share of the dollar or an obstinate type that commits to claiming a certain share of the dollar. Efficiency and surplus distribution in majoritarian reputational bargaining may differ from their counterparts in bilateral reputational bargaining. In a particular equilibrium of our majoritarian game, efficiency loss vanishes asymptotically as the agents become patient, and bargaining ends immediately if all agents are rational. Moreover, the agent who has the lowest positive ex ante probability of being obstinate achieves the highest ex ante payoff, when such probabilities for all agents are sufficiently low.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究多数规则下的声誉讨价还价。三个代理人在多数规则下就一美元的分配进行讨价还价，提议者随机选择。每个代理人拥有关于其类型的私人信息，即她是最大化其预期美元份额的理性类型，还是承诺要求一定美元份额的固执类型。多数规则下声誉讨价还价中的效率与剩余分配可能不同于双边声誉讨价还价中的对应情况。在我们的多数规则博弈的一个特定均衡中，随着代理人变得有耐心，效率损失渐近消失，如果所有代理人都是理性的，讨价还价立即结束。此外，当所有代理人的事前固执概率足够低时，事前固执概率最低的正值代理人获得最高的事前收益。

articles.abstract_en: This paper studies implications of return extrapolation in a consumption-based asset pricing model. We show that return extrapolation has strong implications for the pricing kernel. The time variation in the agent's return expectations is mainly reflected in the short rate and little in return volatility and equity premium. Return extrapolation causes return volatility and equity premium to be lower than the rational counterparts. In addition to the risk premium, the equity premium can include a sentiment premium that is due to dividend expectation bias rather than return extrapolation bias. Thus, time-varying dividend (rather than return) expectation bias helps produce a volatile equity premium. These results show that return extrapolation exacerbates asset pricing puzzles and fundamental extrapolation helps resolve puzzles.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了基于消费的资产定价模型中收益外推的含义。我们表明，收益外推对定价核有强烈的影响。代理人收益预期的时间变化主要反映在短期利率上，而对收益波动率和股权溢价的影响很小。收益外推导致收益波动率和股权溢价低于理性对应值。除了风险溢价外，股权溢价还可以包括一个情绪溢价，该溢价源于股息预期偏差而非收益外推偏差。因此，时变的股息（而非收益）预期偏差有助于产生波动的股权溢价。这些结果表明，收益外推加剧了资产定价难题，而基本面外推有助于解决这些难题。

articles.abstract_en: Is asset liquidity a source of price volatility? We answer this question within a continuous-time, New Monetarist economy under extrinsic uncertainty where the role of an asset to finance expenditure shocks depends on its pledgeability. If assets are intrinsically valuable and pledgeability is exogenous, then their prices are invariant to extrinsic uncertainty – unlike environments with discrete-time pricing that can feature sunspot equilibria. We derive conditions under which extrinsic uncertainty matters when pledgeability is endogenous and varies with the asset price or its rate of return. In the latter case, we link sunspot equilibria to deterministic cycles.
articles.abstract_cn: 资产流动性是价格波动的来源吗？我们在一个连续时间的新货币主义经济体中，在外部不确定性下回答这个问题，其中资产在融资支出冲击中的作用取决于其可质押性。如果资产具有内在价值且可质押性是外生的，那么它们的价格对外部不确定性是不变的——这与具有离散时间定价且可能出现太阳黑子均衡的环境不同。我们推导出当可质押性是内生的且随资产价格或其回报率变化时，外部不确定性起作用的条件。在后一种情况下，我们将太阳黑子均衡与确定性周期联系起来。

articles.title_en: Information transmission in voluntary disclosure games
articles.title_cn: 自愿披露博弈中的信息传递
articles.abstract_en: Does a better-informed sender transmit more accurate information in equilibrium? We show that, in a general class of voluntary disclosure games, unlike other strategic communication environments, the answer is positive. If the sender's evidence is more Blackwell informative, then the receiver's equilibrium utility increases. We apply our main result to show that an uninformed sender who chooses a test from a Blackwell-ordered set does so efficiently.
articles.abstract_cn: 在均衡中，信息更充分的发送者会传递更准确的信息吗？我们证明，在一类一般的自愿披露博弈中，与其他战略沟通环境不同，答案是肯定的。如果发送者的证据更具布莱克威尔信息量，那么接收者的均衡效用会增加。我们应用我们的主要结果来表明，一个不知情的发送者从布莱克威尔有序集合中选择测试时，会高效地这样做。

articles.title_en: Opinion aggregation: Borda and Condorcet revisited
articles.title_cn: 意见聚合：重新审视博尔达与孔多塞
articles.abstract_en: In a world admitting a fixed finite set of alternatives, an opinion is an ordered pair of alternatives. Such a pair expresses the idea that one alternative is superior to another in some sense, and an opinion aggregator assigns an aggregate relation on the set of alternatives to every possible state of opinion. Our primary motivation is to extend the standard model of social choice theory to a more general one in which no specific reference to agents generating or holding opinions is needed. Although our analysis has some bearing on those cases where opinions reflect the goodness relations of agents in a society, it is not limited to them. In addition to that interpretation, opinions can also be used to represent other forms of comparative assessments emerging from different sources. The main results of the paper provide characterizations of two essential aggregation methods that remain well-defined in our larger context. These are the Borda rule and Condorcet's majority rule formulated in terms of opinion aggregation. Moreover, we show that these two opinion aggregators agree with the plurality rule and with the approval-voting rule when opinions are generated by ballots that are specific to these two well-established voting rules.
articles.abstract_cn: 在一个承认固定有限备选方案集合的世界中，一个意见是备选方案的有序对。这样的有序对表达了某一备选方案在某种意义下优于另一备选方案的想法，而意见聚合器将备选方案集合上的一个聚合关系分配给每一种可能的意见状态。我们的主要动机是将社会选择理论的标准模型扩展到一个更一般的模型，在该模型中无需具体提及产生或持有意见的个体。尽管我们的分析对意见反映社会中个体优劣关系的情况有一定影响，但并不限于此。除了这种解释外，意见还可以用来表示来自不同来源的其他形式的比较评估。本文的主要结果提供了在我们更大背景下仍然定义良好的两种基本聚合方法的特征刻画。这两种方法是博尔达规则和以意见聚合形式表述的孔多塞多数规则。此外，我们表明，当意见由特定于这两种既定投票规则的选票产生时，这两种意见聚合器与 plurality 规则和 approval-voting 规则一致。

articles.title_en: Asset bubbles, entrepreneurial risks, and economic growth
articles.title_cn: 资产泡沫、创业风险与经济增长
articles.abstract_en: Entrepreneurs are exposed to large uninsured risks, which may discourage them from creating productive assets. This may generate productive asset shortages and stimulate speculative demand for bubbles. This study introduces uninsured entrepreneurial risks into a textbook growth model with infinitely-lived agents. In the model, entrepreneurs face no credit constraints. If the degree of entrepreneurial risks is in the middle range, bubbles are likely to emerge. If the degree is high, bubbles promote growth because of the wealth effect. Otherwise, bubbles lower growth. The effect of the collapse of bubbles also depends on the degree of the risks. Moreover, asset bubbles amplify a small and temporal negative technology shock.
articles.abstract_cn: 创业者面临大量未保险的风险，这可能阻碍他们创造生产性资产。这可能导致生产性资产短缺，并刺激对泡沫的投机需求。本研究将未保险的创业风险引入一个具有无限期生命主体的教科书式增长模型中。在该模型中，创业者不面临信贷约束。如果创业风险程度处于中等范围，泡沫可能出现。如果风险程度较高，泡沫会通过财富效应促进增长。否则，泡沫会降低增长。泡沫破裂的影响也取决于风险程度。此外，资产泡沫会放大一个微小且暂时的负面技术冲击。

articles.title_en: The negative value of private information in illiquid markets
articles.title_cn: 非流动性市场中私人信息的负价值
articles.abstract_en: In the standard perfectly competitive rational expectations model of information acquisition, the marginal benefit of private information to each trader is always positive. We show that with imperfect competition, characterized by a finite number of traders, the value of private information can be negative, resulting in a zero-information equilibrium even if information is free. This zero-information equilibrium arises when noise-trading volume is sufficiently large that price informativeness is weak, and when noise traders are sufficiently bullish or bearish. Given the evidence suggesting that retail traders behave as noise traders, our findings suggest that retail traders can play a significant role in investors' information-acquisition decisions in financial markets.
articles.abstract_cn: 在标准完全竞争理性预期信息获取模型中，私人信息对每个交易者的边际收益总是正的。我们证明，在不完全竞争（以有限数量的交易者为特征）下，私人信息的价值可能为负，即使信息免费也会导致零信息均衡。当噪声交易量足够大以至于价格信息含量较弱，且噪声交易者足够看多或看空时，就会出现这种零信息均衡。鉴于有证据表明散户交易者表现为噪声交易者，我们的研究结果表明，散户交易者在金融市场投资者的信息获取决策中可以发挥重要作用。

articles.title_en: Maxmin expected utility in Savage's framework
articles.title_cn: Savage框架下的最大最小期望效用
articles.abstract_en: We axiomatize the maxmin expected utility model in Savage's original framework, which does not require a rich set of consequences nor objective probabilities. The key conditions in our result reformulate Gilboa–Schmeidler's (1989) Uncertainty Aversion and Certainty Independence for Savage's acts. Also, we propose a definition for comparative ambiguity aversion in this context.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在Savage的原始框架中对最大最小期望效用模型进行了公理化，该框架既不要求丰富的后果集，也不要求客观概率。我们结果中的关键条件重新表述了Gilboa–Schmeidler（1989）的不确定性厌恶和确定性独立性，适用于Savage的行为。此外，我们在此背景下提出了比较模糊厌恶的定义。

articles.abstract_en: We consider a dynamic inspection problem between a principal and several agents. The principal observes the full inspection history, whereas each agent only observes inspections imposed on himself. When inspection resources are limited, the inspection intensities for agents are negatively correlated, and hence each agent cares not only about his own inspection history, but also about the inspection histories of the other agents. In such cases, should the principal publicly reveal past inspection history, or should she conceal this information? We show that the principal benefits from concealing inspection history. Nevertheless, this benefit becomes less significant as the number of agents increases, and disappears in the limit case with a continuum of agents.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一个委托人与多个代理人之间的动态检查问题。委托人观察完整的检查历史，而每个代理人只观察施加在自己身上的检查。当检查资源有限时，各代理人的检查强度呈负相关，因此每个代理人不仅关心自己的检查历史，还关心其他代理人的检查历史。在这种情况下，委托人应该公开过去的检查历史，还是应该隐瞒这一信息？我们表明，委托人从隐瞒检查历史中获益。然而，随着代理人数量增加，这种收益变得不那么显著，并在代理人连续统的极限情况下消失。

articles.title_en: Repeated communication with private lying costs
articles.title_cn: 具有私人说谎成本的重复沟通
articles.abstract_en: I study a repeated communication game between a patient sender and a sequence of myopic receivers. The sender has persistent private information about his cost of lying. Each period, the sender privately observes an i.i.d. state and recommends an action. The receiver takes an action after observing this recommendation and the full history of states and recommendations. I provide conditions under which a sufficiently patient sender can attain his optimal commitment payoff in the repeated game. My results provide justifications for the commitment assumption in Bayesian persuasion models using a repeated communication game without any commitment. My results also imply that the sender's equilibrium payoff is not monotone with respect to the receiver's belief about his lying cost.
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究了一个有耐心的发送者与一系列短视接收者之间的重复沟通博弈。发送者对其说谎成本拥有持久的私人信息。每个时期，发送者私下观察一个独立同分布的状态并推荐一个行动。接收者在观察到这一推荐以及状态和推荐的完整历史后采取行动。我提供了条件，在这些条件下，一个足够有耐心的发送者可以在重复博弈中达到其最优承诺收益。我的结果为贝叶斯说服模型中无需任何承诺的重复沟通博弈中的承诺假设提供了合理性依据。我的结果还意味着，发送者的均衡收益相对于接收者对其说谎成本的信念不是单调的。

articles.title_cn: 繁荣与萧条中的羊群行为
articles.abstract_en: This paper explores whether rational herding can generate endogenous aggregate fluctuations. We embed a tractable model of rational herding into a business cycle framework. In the model, technological innovations arrive with unknown qualities, and agents have dispersed information about how productive the technology really is. Rational investors decide whether to invest based on their private information and the investment behavior of others. Herd-driven boom-bust cycles arise endogenously in this environment when the technology is unproductive but investors' initial information is overly optimistic. Their overoptimism leads to high investment rates, which investors mistakenly attribute to good fundamentals, leading to a self-reinforcing pattern of higher optimism and higher investment until the economy reaches a peak, followed by a crash when agents ultimately realize their mistake. We calibrate the model to the U.S. economy and show that it can broadly explain boom-and-bust cycles like the dot-com bubble of the 1990s.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文探讨理性羊群行为能否产生内生总体波动。我们将一个易处理的理性羊群行为模型嵌入商业周期框架。在模型中，技术创新的质量未知，代理人关于技术实际生产率的信息分散。理性投资者根据私人信息和其他人的投资行为决定是否投资。当技术无生产力但投资者初始信息过于乐观时，羊群驱动的繁荣-萧条周期在该环境中内生出现。他们的过度乐观导致高投资率，投资者错误地将其归因于良好的基本面，从而形成更高乐观和更高投资的自我强化模式，直到经济达到顶峰，随后当代理人最终意识到错误时崩溃。我们将模型校准到美国经济，并表明它可以大致解释如1990年代互联网泡沫那样的繁荣-萧条周期。

articles.title_en: Public disclosure and private information acquisition: A global game approach
articles.title_cn: 公开披露与私人信息获取：一种全局博弈方法
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies public information disclosure in a model of dynamic financial markets with endogenous information acquisition. Due to an information complementarity, multiple equilibria may emerge, complicating comparative statics analysis. By adding noise to agents' information costs, we establish equilibrium uniqueness using global-game techniques. We show that while public information always crowds out private information in all underlying equilibria, it can crowd in private information acquisition in the unique global-game equilibrium. This result is driven by the strategic uncertainty introduced through the global-game refinement. The crowding-in effect is more pronounced when there is a high level of fundamental uncertainty, which supports the case for greater information disclosure during times of increased market volatility.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文在具有内生信息获取的动态金融市场模型中研究公开信息披露。由于信息互补性，可能出现多重均衡，这使得比较静态分析复杂化。通过在代理人的信息成本中加入噪声，我们利用全局博弈技术建立了均衡唯一性。我们表明，虽然公开信息在所有潜在均衡中总是挤出私人信息，但在唯一的全局博弈均衡中，它可以挤入私人信息获取。这一结果是由通过全局博弈精炼引入的战略不确定性驱动的。当基本不确定性水平较高时，挤入效应更为显著，这支持在市场波动加剧时期增加信息披露的理由。

articles.title_en: Marital preferences and stable matching in cultural evolution
articles.title_cn: 文化演化中的婚姻偏好与稳定匹配
articles.abstract_en: Building on previous literature that examines the influence of intergenerational transmission in cultural evolution, we highlight the importance of the marriage market in the determination of cultural homogeneity (“melting pot”) versus heterogeneity (“diversity”). To do so, we characterize cultural evolutionary processes under different distributions of marital preferences and stable matching schemes. In our setting, cultural substitutability (Bisin and Verdier, 2001) is neither sufficient nor necessary for cultural heterogeneity. We introduce a new concept, elasticity of cultural substitution, to capture the degree of increase in vertical socialization efforts in response to minority population decline. With perfect or inelastic vertical transmission in homogamous families, cultural heterogeneity is sustained only if all proposers are homophilic or all members of a cultural group are homophilic. With imperfect vertical transmission in homogamous families, the presence of heterophilic agents may destabilize cultural heterogeneity, and the proportion of heterophilic agents and elasticity of cultural substitution determine whether cultural heterogeneity can be sustained. We discuss the model's implications for the long-lasting impact of temporary gender imbalance on cultural evolution as well as the cultural assimilation and preservation of minorities and immigrants under distinct governmental and religious attitudes toward intermarriage.
articles.abstract_cn: 基于先前研究代际传递在文化演化中影响的文献，我们强调婚姻市场在决定文化同质性（“熔炉”）与异质性（“多样性”）中的重要性。为此，我们在不同的婚姻偏好分布和稳定匹配方案下刻画了文化演化过程。在我们的设定中，文化替代性（Bisin和Verdier，2001）既不是文化异质性的充分条件也不是必要条件。我们引入了一个新概念，文化替代弹性，用以捕捉垂直社会化努力随少数群体人口下降而增加的程度。在同质婚家庭中，若垂直传递完美或无弹性，则只有当所有提议者均为同质偏好或某一文化群体的所有成员均为同质偏好时，文化异质性才能持续。在同质婚家庭中垂直传递不完美的情况下，异质偏好个体的存在可能破坏文化异质性，而异质偏好个体的比例和文化替代弹性决定了文化异质性能否持续。我们讨论了该模型对暂时性性别失衡对文化演化的长期影响，以及在不同政府和宗教对通婚态度下少数群体和移民的文化同化与保留的启示。

articles.title_en: Allocating losses: Bail-ins, bailouts and bank regulation
articles.title_cn: 损失分配：内部纾困、外部纾困与银行监管
articles.abstract_en: We study the interaction between the government's bailout policy and a bank's willingness to impose losses on (or “bail in”) investors based on its private information. In the absence of regulation, bail-ins in the early stages of a crisis are too small, while bailouts are too large and too frequent. Moreover, the bank may face a run by informed investors, creating further distortions and leading to a larger bailout. We show how a regulator with limited information can raise welfare and, in some cases, improve financial stability. The optimal policy involves partial delegation: the regulator sets bounds on the size of the bank's bail-in, but allows the bank to choose within these bounds.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了政府的纾困政策与银行基于其私人信息向投资者施加损失（或“内部纾困”）的意愿之间的相互作用。在缺乏监管的情况下，危机初期的内部纾困规模过小，而外部纾困规模过大且过于频繁。此外，银行可能面临知情投资者的挤兑，造成进一步扭曲并导致更大的外部纾困。我们展示了信息有限的监管者如何能够提高福利，并在某些情况下改善金融稳定。最优政策涉及部分授权：监管者对银行的内部纾困规模设定界限，但允许银行在这些界限内进行选择。

articles.title_en: Doubts about the model and optimal policy
articles.title_cn: 对模型的疑虑与最优政策
articles.abstract_en: This paper analyzes optimal policy in setups where both the policymaker and the private sector have doubts about the probability model of uncertainty and form endogenous worst-case beliefs. There are two forces that shape optimal policy results: a) the manipulation of the endogenous beliefs of the private sector so that the forward-looking constraints that the policymaker is facing are relaxed, b) the discrepancy (if any) in pessimistic beliefs between a paternalistic policymaker and the private sector, which captures ultimately differences in welfare evaluation. I illustrate the methodology in an optimal fiscal policy problem and show that manipulation of beliefs materializes as an effort to make government debt cheaper through the endogenous beliefs of the household. This force may lead to either mitigation or amplification of the household's pessimism, depending on the problem's parameters. The policymaker's relative pessimism determines whether paternalism reinforces or opposes the price manipulation incentives.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文分析了在政策制定者和私人部门都对不确定性的概率模型存有疑虑并形成内生最坏情况信念的环境中的最优政策。塑造最优政策结果的有两股力量：a) 操纵私人部门的内生信念，以放松政策制定者面临的向前看的约束；b) 家长式政策制定者与私人部门之间悲观信念的差异（如果有的话），这最终反映了福利评估的差异。我在一个最优财政政策问题中阐述了该方法，并表明信念的操纵表现为通过家庭的内生信念使政府债务更便宜的努力。这股力量可能导致家庭悲观情绪的缓解或放大，具体取决于问题的参数。政策制定者的相对悲观程度决定了家长式作风是强化还是反对价格操纵激励。

articles.title_en: The A/B testing problem with Gaussian priors
articles.title_cn: 高斯先验下的A/B测试问题
articles.abstract_en: A risk-neutral firm can perform a randomized experiment (A/B test) to learn about the effects of implementing an idea of unknown quality. The firm's goal is to decide the experiment's sample size and whether or not the idea should be implemented after observing the experiment's outcome. We show that when the distribution for idea quality is Gaussian and there are linear costs of experimentation, there are exact formulae for the firm's optimal implementation decisions, the value of obtaining more data, and optimal experiment sizes. Our formulae—which assume that companies use randomized experiments to help them maximize expected profits—provide a simple alternative to i) the standard rules-of-thumb of power calculations for determining the sample size of an experiment, and also to ii) ad hoc thresholds based on statistical significance to interpret the outcome of an experiment.
articles.abstract_cn: 一个风险中性的企业可以进行随机实验（A/B测试）来了解实施一个质量未知的想法的效果。企业的目标是决定实验的样本量以及在观察实验结果后是否应该实施该想法。我们表明，当想法质量的分布为高斯分布且实验成本为线性时，存在关于企业最优实施决策、获取更多数据的价值以及最优实验规模的精确公式。我们的公式——假设公司使用随机实验来帮助其最大化预期利润——为确定实验样本量的标准功效计算经验法则以及基于统计显著性来解释实验结果的临时阈值提供了一种简单的替代方案。
